goal: Requires a dedicated Tor bind so automatic onion service traffic can't be misclassified as direct connections
Prevents Tor peers from silently inheriting IP-based permissions like whitelist noban meant for direct connections
reviewability: Paused: waiting on author to respond to a material follow-up concern raised 9 days ago
Review is worthwhile but scope may still change pending the author's reply on wildcard binds
agreement: Concept and approach ACKs from two reviewers with no objection to the core mechanism (jeanpablojp, winterrdog)
Unaddressed objection: wildcard onion binds still leak IP-based permissions, no author reply (jeanpablojp)
Nit about test style not blocking (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it closes a real misconfiguration where Tor-forwarded connections could inherit IP-based whitelist permissions
Affects any operator running listenonion with an explicit bind and no dedicated onion bind
Not P1 since it requires a specific misconfiguration and a known wildcard-bind variant of the leak remains open
